0985 What Network? If you’ve encountered a mobile number starting with 0985, you may have wondered which network it belongs to. With so many telecom providers in the Philippines, it’s understandable to be unsure. This article will help clarify things for you!

0985 is a mobile prefix number that is owned and operated by Smart Communications or Talk ‘N Text, which are part of the PLDT Group, one of the leading telecom companies in the Philippines.

While Smart Communications is known for its high-tech services, Talk ‘N Text offers budget-friendly options. But how can you tell which one you’re dealing with, and what services do they provide?

Let’s dive into the details of 0985, and I’ll explain everything you need to know, including who owns this prefix, the services offered by both Smart Communications and Talk ‘N Text, and how you can check the network of any prefix.

0985 What Network?

You’ve come across a number starting with 0985, and now you’re asking, “Which network is this from?” The simple answer is that 0985 belongs to either Smart Communications or Talk ‘N Text. Both of these telecom providers fall under the same parent company, PLDT Inc., but they serve slightly different market segments.

In the Philippines, mobile phone numbers are divided into prefixes, which are identifiers that tell you which network a number belongs to. The prefix 0985 is one such identifier that can be used to find out whether the number is from Smart Communications or Talk ‘N Text.
For users, knowing the network can be helpful because different telecom providers offer unique services, pricing plans, and network benefits like call rates, data speeds, and more.

Introduction to Smart Communications and Talk ‘N Text
Smart Communications

Smart Communications is one of the biggest and most reliable telecom providers in the Philippines. Established in 1991, it has been a pioneer in offering cutting-edge mobile and broadband services. Smart is owned by PLDT Inc., which also owns Talk ‘N Text. Smart Communications has built a reputation for offering fast and reliable mobile services, making it a preferred choice for millions of Filipino users.

Smart is particularly known for its advanced 5G network, which offers lightning-fast internet speeds, making it ideal for data-heavy tasks like video streaming, online gaming, and remote work. The company also offers mobile wallets, entertainment streaming services, and smart home solutions to enhance the digital experience for its users.

Talk ‘N Text

Talk ‘N Text, also owned by PLDT Inc., is a popular network in the Philippines that focuses on providing affordable mobile services. While Smart targets customers looking for advanced mobile services, Talk ‘N Text has always been committed to delivering budget-friendly prepaid plans, catering to users who want more value for their money without compromising basic services.

Talk ‘N Text is particularly well-regarded for its affordable call and text packages, which are great for casual users who want to save on mobile expenses. It is also widely available in both urban and rural areas, ensuring that users across the country enjoy competitive coverage and affordable rates.

What Services Do Smart Communications and Talk ‘N Text Offer?

Both Smart Communications and Talk ‘N Text offer a range of services to cater to the diverse needs of their customers. Whether you’re a heavy data user, need high-speed internet, or are looking for an affordable mobile plan, both networks have you covered. Let’s look at their key offerings.

1. Mobile Service

Both Smart Communications and Talk ‘N Text offer prepaid and postpaid plans, providing flexibility for different types of users.

Prepaid Plans:

Prepaid plans are great for users who want to pay as they go without committing to a monthly subscription. These plans usually include voice calls, text messages, and data. You can easily top up your balance at retail stores, through the website, or via mobile apps.


Postpaid Plans:

Postpaid plans are for users who prefer the convenience of a fixed monthly bill. These plans often come with unlimited calls, texts, and large data allocations, along with perks like smartphone bundles and exclusive rewards.

2. Broadband Services 

Both networks provide broadband services, catering to both home and mobile users.

Fiber Internet:

Smart Communications offers high-speed fiber internet plans that can provide speeds from 10 Mbps to over 1000 Mbps, perfect for heavy internet users, gamers, and businesses.


Wireless Broadband:

Smart and Talk ‘N Text also provide wireless broadband solutions, such as mobile Wi-Fi devices that work with both prepaid and postpaid plans. This gives users more flexibility to stay connected wherever they go.

3. Digital Services

Both Smart Communications and Talk ‘N Text are leading the charge in digital innovation. They offer a wide array of digital services to enhance your life beyond just mobile communication:

PayMaya (Digital Wallet):

This mobile wallet app allows users to send money, pay bills, buy mobile load, and shop online directly from their phones, making it a convenient payment solution for many Filipinos.

Entertainment Streaming:

Both Smart and Talk ‘N Text offer exclusive entertainment content through partnerships with major streaming platforms. Users can access music, movies, and TV shows on the go.

Smart Home Services:

Both networks also provide smart home solutions, allowing users to manage their home devices (e.g., lights, security) from their phones.

4. International Roaming

Smart and Talk ‘N Text offer international roaming services, so you can stay connected with family, friends, and business contacts even when you’re abroad.


5. Business Solutions

Both Smart Communications and Talk ‘N Text cater to business customers with a variety of solutions like private networks, cloud computing, enterprise communication systems, and more. These services help businesses stay efficient and competitive.


How to Register with Smart Communications or Talk ‘N Text

Whether you’re looking to get a prepaid or postpaid plan, registration with Smart Communications or Talk ‘N Text is simple.

Prepaid Registration

Purchase a SIM card: You can buy a Smart or Talk ‘N Text SIM card at authorized retail outlets or online.

Activate your SIM: Follow the activation instructions that come with the SIM card, or visit the provider’s website for more details.

Top up your balance: You can add credits through various methods like the website, mobile app, or retail stores.

Postpaid Registration

Visit a store: Go to a Smart or Talk ‘N Text store to apply for a postpaid plan.

Bring required documents: You’ll need identification and proof of address (requirements may vary).

Start using your postpaid plan: Once your application is approved, you’ll receive your SIM card, and you can begin enjoying your postpaid benefits.

Features of Smart Communications and Talk ‘N Text

Both Smart and Talk ‘N Text offer excellent features to make your mobile experience more enjoyable.

Wide Coverage: With extensive coverage across the country, both networks ensure you stay connected even in rural areas.

Fast Data Speeds: Thanks to their ongoing 5G rollout, you can expect faster and more stable connections for all your data-heavy activities.

Flexible Plans: Both networks offer plans that cater to different types of users, whether you’re a casual user or someone who needs a large amount of data.

Great Customer Service: With responsive customer support available via call centers, chat, and social media, both Smart and Talk ‘N Text prioritize customer satisfaction.

How to Check the Network of Any Prefix Yourself

If you’re ever uncertain which network a number belongs to, you can easily check using a few methods:

Online Tools:

There are several websites that allow you to check the network for any prefix. These are free and easy to use.

Mobile Apps:

By entering the prefix, several mobile apps can help you identify which telecom provider a number belongs to.

Manual Lookup:

If you’re familiar with the most common prefixes of major telecom providers like Globe, Smart, and TNT, you can manually check which network a number belongs to.

Conclusion

0985 What Network? If you come across a number starting with 0985, it’s registered with Smart Communications or Talk ‘N Text. These networks, part of PLDT Inc., offer a wide range of services catering to all users, from affordable prepaid options to high-speed broadband internet. With their strong presence in the Philippines, both Smart and Talk ‘N Text continue to innovate and provide users with the best possible mobile experience.

Key Takeaways:

0985 belongs to Smart Communications or Talk ‘N Text.

Both networks offer mobile services, broadband internet, and digital services like PayMaya.

You can easily check the network of any number using online tools or apps.
